messages:
kelly: heads-up: bringing up v5-candidate (fp16->mixed-int4) as a staged promote. Early eval shows decent token cost reduction but we see split behavior by session-length and KV-warm state. Opening thread to lock down rollout gates and soft vs hard-fallback semantics.
andre: do we have slice deltas? latency, MRR, hallucination, sample counts?
kelly: quick summary: cost down ~22% overall. Global MRR -0.3% (n=60k). Session-long slice (>= 2500 tokens across multi-turn) n=2.8k, MRR -2.6%, hallucination +1.1%. Cold sessions (no KV warm) show p95 +120ms; warm sessions p95 ~+8ms.
lucas: that suggests a KV-warm dependency. We should treat 'cold-session' as a protected slice with stricter gates. Propose: soft-fallback = throttled traffic rollback (decrease traffic by 50% for 15m) when watch thresholds hit; hard-fallback = immediate 100% rollback for protected slices.
ops-bot: deploy id dpl-17777-v5 started 1777768000 routing=3%. smoke: pass 46/50, failing cases concentrated in session-long and cold-session slices.
kelly: proposed gating rules (high-level):
- global auto-fallback (hard) if global MRR drop >= 1.6% sustained 20m AND samples>=12k AND delta > 1.5*stderr.
- protected slice: cold-session OR legal: hard-fallback if MRR drop >= 1.0% for 5m OR hallucination delta >=0.7% immediate.
- soft-fallback: if slice MRR drop between 0.6% and protected threshold -> reduce traffic by 50% for 15m and turn on shadow mode for 6h.
- latency guard: if p95 increases >100ms for 10m across top-3 slices -> soft-fallback; >180ms -> hard-fallback.
andre: add min-sample rule for slice gates: require >=2000 samples in window to trigger hard-fallback unless immediate flag. Also hysteresis: require condition in 2/3 consecutive windows to avoid flips.
lucas: can we add an adaptive multiplier for int4 variants based on seq-len distribution? e.g., for slices where avg-seqlen >2000 increase sensitivity by factor 1.4.
kelly: yes. That becomes part of the rollout policy: slice_sensitivity_multiplier = 1.4 for long-session cohorts.
infra: dropping config snippet for ops to push (ops will validate schema):

```yaml
rollout_policy: mixed-int4-candidate
auto_fallback:
  global:
    mrr_drop_pct: 1.6
    persistence_mins: 20
    min_samples: 12000
    stderr_mult: 1.5
  protected_slices:
    cold_session:
      mrr_drop_pct: 1.0
      hallucination_pct: 0.7
      persistence_mins: 5
      immediate: true
  soft_fallback:
    mrr_drop_lower: 0.6
    reduction_pct: 50
    hold_mins: 15
  latency_guard:
    p95_soft_ms: 100
    p95_hard_ms: 180
  slice_sensitivity_multiplier:
    long_session: 1.4
watch_only:
  global_mrr_pct: 0.4
  hallucination_pct: 0.3
```

kelly: ops: please wire the soft/hard behavior into the promote controller and ensure a one-click manual-override in console.
andre: I'll run a bootstrap on cold_session slice (resample) and compute stderr + p-values. ETA ~30m. If stderr*1.5 < observed delta and samples>2k we'll auto-rollback.
ops-bot: shadow-run enabled for dpl-17777-v5 for 12h starting 1777770300.
lucas: also please export failing prompts for the failing cohort into a protected bucket (PII redaction), label with seed and prompt-hash so eval team can reproduce.
elizabeth: tagging legal for bucket access.
kelly: agreed action items: 1) push rollout policy to staging, 2) enable 12h shadow, 3) bootstrap numbers from andre, 4) ops to wire soft/hard fallback + manual override. Hold further promote until we get bootstrap.
andre: bootstrap initial: cold_session MRR delta -2.3%, stderr 0.45%, samples 2.2k -> delta > 1.5*stderr and samples>2k. Filing hard-fallback per policy in 5m if no improvement.
ops-bot: initiating hard rollback for dpl-17777-v5: routing 3% -> 0% starting 1777771920. status: in-progress.
kelly: thanks team. follow-up: schedule a small focused eval harness that replays multi-turn KV-warmup sequences with int4 quant packs + a targeted fine-tune on the failing slice.
